note: Writing one section changes only that section; every other byte (comments, spacing, other sections, line endings) is kept. Last argument is the platform EOL, used only when the text has no line breaks yet.

cases.name: new file uses the platform line ending
replace in the middle keeps comments, spacing and other sections byte for byte
